children: Camden Property Trust’s revenue declined 3.7% year over year, while earnings rose sharply, driven primarily by substantially higher gains on property sales. Results also reflected an $86.4 million impairment charge on land development activities.
¹ Reported as “Property revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to common shareholders”. ³ Reported as “Earnings per share – diluted”.
: Same-store NOI decreased $0.3 million, as lower revenue was partly offset by lower expenses.
: Acquired eight operating properties for approximately $754.5 million during the nine months ended September 30, 2026.
: Sold 11 California properties with 3,620 apartment homes for approximately $1.6 billion in July.
: Four properties totaling 1,560 apartment homes were under construction; estimated additional completion costs were $209.3 million.
